# starling

> Local AI in .NET, with no Python sidecar and no API key: embeddings, entity extraction, image and video search and chat on ONNX Runtime (CPU/CUDA), through Microsoft.Extensions.AI.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://starling.rocks): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
